objective.description: Investigar una oportunidad real de comercio electrónico desde cero y determinar, sin promesas, si existe evidencia suficiente para avanzar por etapas hacia utilidad recurrente escalable.

known_context.statement: El capital máximo declarado para un experimento posterior es USD 750.
La región inicial declarada es Estados Unidos.
No existe autorización para gastar o ejecutar acciones comerciales en esta fase.

preferences.statement: Minimizar trabajo físico cuando sea posible.
Minimizar complejidad logística cuando sea posible.

hard_constraints: No exceder USD 750 de capital inicial sin una nueva aprobación humana explícita.
No gastar, comprar, vender, publicar listings, abrir cuentas, contratar servicios o contactar proveedores en esta fase.
No usar scraping prohibido ni fuentes incompatibles con términos aplicables.
No almacenar credenciales, tokens, secretos o PII en Git, documentación, fixtures, logs o reportes.
No presentar Sandbox, fixtures, simulaciones, estimaciones o backtests como mercado o resultados reales.
No modificar Opportunity Score ni fórmulas existentes para este caso.
Toda promoción a BusinessPath y toda acción comercial requieren intervención humana explícita.

loss_limits.rule: No stage may risk capital until its amount, recovery conditions and stop trigger are approved by a human.

abandonment_criteria: Demonstrated legal, platform-policy or safety incompatibility.
Conservative unit economics are clearly non-viable and no material variable remains unresolved.
Minimum viable validation requires capital above the approved ceiling.
Required sourcing or data acquisition would violate applicable terms.
Operational burden is demonstrably incompatible with a later human-approved hard constraint.
An essential premise is invalidated by current, verified and applicable evidence.

allowed: Official public marketplace and regulator sources within their published terms.
Approved APIs and existing Oriva capabilities within their exact semantic scope.
Authorized supplier quotations or documents only after separate human approval.
Manual observations whose provenance, date, method and limitations are recorded.
prohibited: Prohibited scraping or circumvention of access controls.
Credentials or private account data not explicitly authorized.
Fixtures, Sandbox or synthetic values represented as live commercial evidence.
Undocumented aggregate scores, invented probabilities or unattributed claims.

initial_decision.meaning: Insufficient evidence to select or fund a candidate; proceed only with evidence acquisition that requires no commercial action or spend.
